description: Deterministic large-repository contract tasks used to validate V12 weak-model context/routing foundations before live model runs.

tasks.objective: Trace a regression across package boundaries without loading the entire generated monorepo into context.
Change a public API field and identify the API producer and web consumer that must move together.
acceptance: Contract producer and consumer are both discovered

tasks.objective: Diagnose a defect near the end of a fifty-module import chain using bounded evidence expansion.
acceptance: Recovery can expand around the failing chain

tasks.objective: Coordinate a refactor touching several package endpoints while serializing shared contract writes.
acceptance: Shared contract changes are treated as a write-conflict surface
